purpose: Compare frozen versus candidate-refreshed outcome predictions in repeated held-out DR acceptance gates on real chronological randomized video exposures.
research_question: Under the fixed group-policy model and daily reviews, does refreshing gate outcome predictions change selected policies and their subsequent long-view value?
not_tested: A new causal or doubly robust estimator
Actual deployment or policy-induced user feedback
Individual counterfactual truth or oracle regret

dataset.name: KuaiRand-Pure
dataset.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0; retain archive LICENSE and attribution
dataset.citation: Gao et al. (2022), KuaiRand: An Unbiased Sequential Recommendation Dataset with Randomly Exposed Videos, CIKM, doi:10.1145/3511808.3557624
dataset.eligibility: is_rand == 1 and tab == 1; all three catalogue duration groups retained
dataset.excluded: Ordinary recommendation logs and released user/video aggregate statistics
dataset.cohort_scope: Published cohort retained users with at least ten random exposures. Do not assume transport to all platform users.
identification_assumptions: Uniform random insertion from the documented fixed catalogue is applicable to the analysed intervention records and published selected cohort.
The fixed catalogue group mapping defines a policy that samples uniformly among its member videos; group propensities are conditional on random insertion, not probabilities for ordinary feed traffic.
Recorded timestamps and predecision user identities are usable, and catalogue duration is treated as fixed metadata; its snapshot limitations must be disclosed.
Value is evaluated on logged contexts. This does not identify effects of changing entire feeds, retention, future user states or future cohort selection.

prior_exposure.pilot_findings: Both gates rejected. Initial policy DR/IPS approximately 0.075061/0.075792; always-long approximately 0.082995/0.082884 in the subsequent development window. Retain all baselines.

time.clock: Decode time_ms explicitly as Unix milliseconds; never infer integer datetime units.
time.mismatch_direction: timestamp-derived local date one day earlier than recorded date
time.mismatch_handling: Retain records and mismatch flag; no retrospective deletion based on outcomes.
time.input_not_assumed_chronologically_sorted: Sort by time_ms and original CSV row index using a stable sort.
time.initial_scope: All available records in the three exposed development dates; the first date is partially observed. This differs from the pilot initial two-date model.
time.candidate_training: Previous date 12:00 to current date 12:00; rolling 24 hours, using only past logged outcomes.
time.subsequent_evaluation: Current date 18:00 to next date 00:00, using available records; report observed endpoints.
time.training_overlap: Initial and rolling candidate training may overlap; earlier evaluation records may enter a later rolling training window only after they are past observations.

definitions.unknown: Missing, nonnumeric, nonfinite or nonpositive catalogue duration.

policy_class.learned_policy: Choose highest predicted long-view-probability group, then uniformly sample a catalogue video within that group; first group in declared order breaks ties.
policy_class.uniform_baseline: Uniform over all 7583 catalogue videos; group probabilities equal catalogue counts/7583, not 1/3.

model.implementation_reference: Reuse classify, features, fit, predict, scores and decision from run_kuairand_pilot.py at commit b213e6c.
model.preprocessing: Sparse DictVectorizer and MaxAbsScaler fitted separately on each training partition; unseen categories ignored by the trained mapping.

gates.frozen_q: Single initial outcome model fitted on the three development dates.
gates.refreshed_q: Current date candidate outcome model fitted on preceding 24 hours before noon.
gates.rule: Mean paired DR(candidate minus current incumbent) - 1.96 row standard errors strictly greater than zero.
gates.zero_match_rule: For each gate independently reject if candidate or its own incumbent has zero matching logged groups.
gates.row_SE_limitation: Pointwise heuristic ignoring repeated-user/time dependence; not a sequential safety certificate.

evaluation.outcome: long_view binary as supplied; do not switch outcomes after seeing reserved results.
evaluation.common_q: Current morning candidate outcome model for every policy on that dates same evening rows.
evaluation.logged_action: Catalogue duration group of the logged video.
evaluation.IPS: pi(logged group | context) / p(logged group) * observed long_view.
evaluation.DR: Sum over groups pi(group | context)*q(context,group), plus IPS weight times (observed long_view - q(context,logged group)).
evaluation.primary: Equal-weight mean of all 14 within-date evening DR differences: refreshed_gate_path minus frozen_gate_path. Positive favors refreshed.
secondary: Each gate versus each of six baselines using both estimators
All 14 daily contrasts and selected model paths
evaluation.units: Estimated long-view probability differences, not measured profit or relative percentage improvements.
evaluation.identical_paths: Report exact cancellation if actions agree; a zero interval is not population equivalence.

primary_exploratory_interval.method: Paired user-cluster percentile bootstrap conditional on fitted and selected paths.
primary_exploratory_interval.clusters: Unique user IDs across the union of all 14 evening evaluation windows.
primary_exploratory_interval.draws: Sample the same number of user IDs with replacement; carry each sampled users complete evaluation records across every date. Use common multiplicities across policies and estimators.
primary_exploratory_interval.aggregation: Recompute each dates row-weighted paired mean using resampled user multiplicities, then average all 14 date means equally.
primary_exploratory_interval.empty_resampled_date: Stop with a recorded error; never omit a date or silently change the method.

temporal_sensitivity_interval.method: Separate paired within-date 30-minute block percentile bootstrap.
temporal_sensitivity_interval.draws: Resample nonempty contiguous 30-minute blocks within each date with common paired draws; recompute date row means then average 14 dates equally.
temporal_sensitivity_interval.purpose: Sensitivity to short-range temporal clustering; not a substitute for user clustering.

limitations: Neither interval is guaranteed population coverage or sequential safety.
Both condition on fitted/selected policy paths and observed dates; neither refits models or captures full training/selection uncertainty.
User resampling does not resolve all common time shocks; within-date time-block resampling does not preserve all repeated-user dependence.
Fourteen adjacent dates are not fourteen independent deployments or long-term regimes.
Report both interval types; never select the narrower or more favorable interval.
uncertainty.secondary_comparisons: Descriptive and exploratory; no unadjusted multiple-comparison superiority claims.
diagnostics: Records, long_views and unique users per training/gate/evaluation window
Each policy matching rows, matching long_views, matching users, weight ESS and largest normalized weight share
Every daily gate estimate, lower bound, zero-match reason and selection
Date-mismatch counts and actual observed time boundaries
uncertainty.ESS_interpretation: Weight concentration diagnostic, not independent sample size or power.

execution.source_comparison: Validate reused pilot bytes against that Git object after normalizing CRLF to LF.
record: Normalized source hashes and source snapshots
execution.first_execution_marker: Create before analysing any reserved outcome; normal invocation refuses an existing marker.
execution.repeat_policy: Only explicitly labelled unchanged-source reproduction; source changes require a disclosed protocol deviation, not automatic retry.
execution.fail_closed: Stop on missing windows, invalid labels/propensities, catalogue mismatch or model convergence failure; preserve partial run and errors. No omitted dates, automatic retuning or favorable stopping.
execution.reserved_outcomes_access_rule: Filter by explicit eligible time window before numeric outcome conversion. A later training window may use only outcomes chronologically available before its gate.
execution.audit_scope: Saved-score and aggregation reconciliation is separate from an independent refit or raw-row reconstruction.

relationship_to_paper1: Independent real-source gate case study extending temporal coverage and user-level diagnostics; supplements simulation and ZOZO evidence without claiming to validate all monitoring arms or establish novelty.
